value.title: Geology Talk (30 minutes) South Rim Village: 2:30 pm
value.shortDescription: Geology Talk Ranger Program - 2:30 pm daily (during summer 2025). Gain insight into Grand Canyon’s unique geologic story. Meet in front of Yavapai Geology Museum. Program duration: 30 minutes. Learn how this immense canyon formed and the science behind the landscape. Knowing some of the stories encoded in the rock layers will enrich your understanding and enhance your experience at Grand Canyon.

value.location: Yavapai Geology Museum at Yavapai Point
value.accessibilityInformation:
The wide, paved path, up the hill from the parking lot (and shuttle bus stop) to the museum, is accessible.

The program may be presented along the paved Canyon Rim Trail, or inside the geology museum, in the event of inclement weather. All locations are wheelchair accessible. 
 

The Kaibab Rim (Orange) Route shuttle bus provides service from Grand Canyon Visitor Center to Yavapai Point and Geology Museum.

value.activityDescription: In a free 30 minute presentation, a park ranger will discus how Grand Canyon formed, along with some of the science behind the scenery.
value.locationDescription: Yavapai Point is located on Village Loop Road, in between Market Plaza and the Grand Caynon Visitor Center. From the far end of the Yavapai Point parking lot, by the shuttle bus stop, walk the paved path up the hill on your left to the stone musuem building, perched on the edge of the canyon rim. Meet the ranger at 11 am, just outside of the building.
value.longDescription:
Enhance your afternoon with quick insights into the geologic story of Grand Canyon at our "Geology Talk" ranger program - presented daily at 2:30 pm (during summer 2025). Meet in front of Yavapai Geology Museum. Learn how this immense canyon formed and the science behind the landscape. The program is 30 minutes long and is accessible.

value.title: History Exhibit - The Amazing Kolb Brothers
value.shortDescription: See the Amazing Kolb Brothers; A Grand Life at Grand Canyon Exhibit - at Kolb Studio, house-turned-museum perched perilously on the precipice in Historic Grand Canyon Village. Examine their antique cameras, study paintings by plein-air artists through the decades, and watch the motion picture of their 1912 trip down the Colorado River.

images.altText: interior of an exhibit hall with a stairway descending from the second story.
images.title: The Amazing Kolb Brothers Exhibit
images.caption: View the Amazing Kolb Brothers Exhibit in historic Kolb Studio through September 5, 2025.

value.accessibilityInformation: The upper level bookstore/shop is accessible. 17 steps descend from the upper level into the exhibit hall. Wheelchair access to the exhibit hall can sometimes be arranged by asking an employee in the store. (This depends upon staff availablility and may not be possible when there is snow or ice by the downstairs entrance).
value.ageDescription: All ages, but minors must be with an adult parent or guardian
value.timeOfDayDescription: During Winter 2025, Kolb Studio is open from 8 am to 6 pm.
value.activityDescription:
See the Amazing Kolb Brothers; a Grand Life at Grand Canyon Exhibit - at Kolb Studio, house-turned-museum, perched perilously on the precipice in Historic Grand Canyon Village. 

Examine their antique cameras, study a collection of Grand Canyon paintings by plein-air artists through the decades, and watch the motion picture of their 1912 "Journey by Boat" down the Colorado River. Above the exhibit hall is a small bookstore/shop operated by Grand Canyon Conservancy.
value.locationDescription: Kolb Studio is located in the Historic District of Grand Canyon Village, just west of Bright Angel Lodge, and near Bright Angel Trailhead. The historic, sprawling, 5-story and 23-room Kolb Studio is perched right on the rim of Grand Canyon. From the Village and Hermit Road bus stops at Hermit Road Interchange, it is a short walk east (towards the village) and up the hill to Bright Angel Trailhead and Kolb Studio.
value.longDescription:
The Amazing Kolb Brothers:
A Grand Life at Grand Canyon

Kolb Studio is open 8 am to 6 pm daily.

If you are planning a visit to Historic Grand Canyon Village on the South Rim this year? We encourage you to stop by Kolb Studio to check out the Amazing Kolb Brothers Exhibit where you can learn about the grand adventures of pioneer photographers, Emery and Ellsworth Kolb.
